plan.title: PR selected item counts on sourcing actions

steps.note: Open the purchase requisitions screen, the required starting point for a PR-based event flow.
Only open purchase requisitions can be selected for sourcing.
Select a purchase requisition containing three line items so both action buttons should reflect a count of 3.

args.goal: Read the Purchase Items button and verify it displays 3 selected items, click Purchase Items, then read the Create Project button in the side panel and verify it also displays 3 items; stop with the side panel showing the Create Project control

steps.note: No catalog assertion directly reads the numeric labels on these two PR action buttons, so inspect and verify both counts in the buyer's current screen.
Confirm the side panel remains open with the Create Project control visible after the count check.
